errors.text: The proposed substitution is not compositionally defined: it gives neither which heavy element to replace preferentially nor the substitution fraction, so it is not a reproducible single intervention.
It misses the target intervention of adding 4.2 at.% Cr and therefore misses the associated approximately 4 vol.% reticulated Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) Laves phase.

The cited evidence does not demonstrate that replacing Hf or Ta with additional Ti or Zr preserves both room-temperature and elevated-temperature strength; the preceding HfNbTaTiZr result instead demonstrates that a lighter, ductile composition can lose substantial high-temperature strength.
No quantitative density, strength, strain, temperature, strain-rate, or statistical rejection thresholds are provided, making the stated falsification rule non-discriminating.
